parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The definition of the pipeline in YAML format. For more information about how to write the YAML content, see https\://help.aliyun.com/document\_detail/2249317.html.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the organization. You can get this ID from the URL in Alibaba Cloud DevOps, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The ID of the pipeline. You can get this ID from the pipeline URL, for example, `https://flow.aliyun.com/pipelines/{pipelineId}/current`.
